023package org.opt4j.gatekeeper.extractors;
024
025import org.opt4j.core.Genotype;
026import org.opt4j.core.Individual;
027import org.opt4j.gatekeeper.FeatureExtractor;
028
029/**
030 * Base class for feature extractors that translate a single, list-like {@link Genotype} into a feature vector with
031 * one feature per genotype element.
032 *
033 * @param <G>
034 *            the supported genotype type
035 */
036public abstract class AbstractGenotypeFeatureExtractor<G extends Genotype> implements FeatureExtractor {
037
038    private final Class<G> genotypeClass;
039    private int featureSize = -1;
040
041    /**
042     * Constructs the extractor.
043     *
044     * @param genotypeClass
045     *            the supported genotype type
046     */
047    protected AbstractGenotypeFeatureExtractor(Class<G> genotypeClass) {
048        this.genotypeClass = genotypeClass;
049    }
050
051    @Override
052    public synchronized float[] extractFeatures(Individual individual) {
053        Genotype raw = individual.getGenotype();
054        if (!genotypeClass.isInstance(raw)) {
055            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected " + genotypeClass.getSimpleName() + " but got " + raw.getClass().getSimpleName());
056        }
057        G genotype = genotypeClass.cast(raw);
058
059        if (featureSize == -1) {
060            featureSize = genotype.size();
061        }
062
063        float[] features = new float[featureSize];
064        for (int i = 0; i < featureSize; i++) {
065            features[i] = extractFeature(genotype, i);
066        }
067        return features;
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Returns the feature of the genotype element at the given index.
072     *
073     * @param genotype
074     *            the genotype
075     * @param index
076     *            the index of the element
077     * @return the feature value
078     */
079    protected abstract float extractFeature(G genotype, int index);
080
081    /**
082     * Normalizes a value to [0.0, 1.0] with respect to its bounds to prevent exploding gradients in the neural
083     * network. Returns 0.0 if the bounds have zero width.
084     *
085     * @param value
086     *            the value
087     * @param min
088     *            the lower bound
089     * @param max
090     *            the upper bound
091     * @return the normalized value
092     */
093    protected static float normalize(double value, double min, double max) {
094        if (max > min) {
095            return (float) ((value - min) / (max - min));
096        }
097        return 0.0f;
098    }
099
100    @Override
101    public int getFeatureVectorSize() {
102        return featureSize;
103    }
104}
